modules.name: transformers.__init__
modules.role: Package facade that exposes the public API through lazy import structure and backend capability checks.

modules.name: transformers.cli
modules.role: Command-line entry layer (`transformers` console script) wiring chat, serve, download, and environment commands.

modules.name: transformers.pipelines
modules.role: Task-oriented inference orchestration that maps user tasks to Auto classes and concrete pipeline implementations.

modules.name: transformers.trainer
modules.role: Main training orchestration engine coordinating datasets, models, optimizers, callbacks, and distributed/integration hooks.

modules.name: transformers.modeling_utils
modules.role: Core model runtime foundation with `PreTrainedModel`, checkpoint loading, device placement, and weight conversion logic.

modules.name: transformers.models.auto
modules.role: Auto-model factory and mapping registry that resolves model/config classes from model identifiers and config types.

modules.name: transformers.generation
modules.role: Text generation subsystem exposing generation config, decoding utilities, logits processors, stopping criteria, and streamers.

modules.name: transformers.integrations
modules.role: Adapters to external runtimes/tools (DeepSpeed, FSDP, Accelerate, logging backends, TP kernels, PEFT).

modules.name: transformers.quantizers
modules.role: Quantization abstraction and auto-quantizer registry used to load, route, and configure low-bit model execution.

modules.name: transformers.data
modules.role: Dataset-side utilities: collators, processors, and classic benchmark helper functions used by training/evaluation flows.

modules.name: transformers.distributed
modules.role: Distributed configuration surface used by model loading/runtime decisions across multi-device execution.

modules.name: transformers.processing_and_tokenization
modules.role: Cross-modal preprocessing contracts (config/tokenizer/processor mixins) shared by pipelines, trainer, and model loading paths.

modules.name: transformers.utils
modules.role: Common foundation utilities: optional dependency detection, hub/cache helpers, logging, lazy module and compatibility helpers.
